Full sweep: 1928 passed / 7 skipped (meets the ≥1928 baseline); `python scripts/sanitization_check.py` passes (1201 files clean). No edits made to the upstream `agent-conventions` repo and no `git subtree push` invoked — that remains operator-handled per D003.
